name: Greedy Axis-Aligned Spatial Partitioning
definition: Creates a disjoint spatial partition of the volume into axis-aligned bounding boxes using a greedy heuristic that minimizes bounding box volume.
summary: Greedy Axis-Aligned Spatial Partitioning recursively splits 3D volumes into axis-aligned bounding boxes to minimize total leaf volume, using local geometric optimization rather than intensity clustering or global projection heuristics.
